---
title: "Stock repositories"
---

The work for a stock in a year is often split over several TAF repositories, each taking data from those before it. Choose a year, then a stock from the gallery, to see its repositories in [ices-taf](https://github.com/ices-taf) and how they are connected. Each picture in the gallery is a small copy of the diagram of the stock, with the boxes coloured by their status.

- **Inputs** to the assessment: the stock coordination repository of the [RDBES workflow](rdbes.qmd), fed by the national estimation repositories, and the survey index and data repositories.
- **Outputs** of the assessment: the forecast and the reference points.
- **Mixed fisheries** repositories, at the end of the chain, take the assessments and forecasts of several stocks.
- Along the top, the **benchmarks**, **reference point** and **rebuilding plan** work that the assessment follows from, but takes no data from directly. The latest of each up to the year chosen is shown.

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_stock-repos.R")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
stock_repos_data()
```

## The repositories

```{=html}
<div class="table-responsive"><table class="table table-sm" id="stock-table"></table></div>
```

## How the status is decided

The light on each repository is its [TAF readiness level](../system/readiness-level.qmd) where one is found: for the assessments, the other types of work under [TAF readiness](readiness.qmd), and the repositories of the [RDBES workflow](rdbes.qmd). The other repositories, such as those for data and forecasts, are shown as **Exists**.

A connection is found in the code of the repository at its end:

- Through the RDBES, as on the [RDBES workflow](rdbes.qmd) page: **connected** when the first repository uploads to the RDBES and the second downloads from it, and **partly connected** when only one of them does.
- Otherwise, **connected** when the `DATA.bib` of the second repository, or a script of an entry in it with `source = {script}`, names the first repository. Data copied in by hand, with `source = {file}`, does not show the connection.

The mixed fisheries and national estimation repositories are not named for a stock. They are shown for a stock when they take data from one of its repositories or give data to one, when the country has data for the stock in [`rdbes-stock-countries.csv`](https://github.com/ices-eg/wg_WGTAFGOV/blob/master/docs/_taf/site/boot/initial/data/rdbes-stock-countries.csv), or when the stock is listed for the repository under `members` in [`repo-types.json`](https://github.com/ices-eg/wg_WGTAFGOV/blob/master/docs/_taf/site/boot/initial/data/repo-types.json). That file also sets the types of repository, by the patterns of their names, and the connections expected between them.

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const data = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("stock-repos-data").textContent);
  const { repos, types, rdbes } = data;
  const byName = new Map(repos.map((r) => [r.name, r]));
  const sourcesOf = (r) => (r && r.sources ? r.sources.split(" ") : []);
  const escRe = (s) => s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
  const esc = (s) => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" })[c]);
  const typeOf = new Map(types.types.map((t) => [t.id, t]));

  // ---- the stocks and their years ----------------------------------------
  const stockYears = new Map();
  for (const r of repos) {
    const m = r.name.match(/^(\d{4})_([a-z]{3}\.[^_]+)/);
    if (!m) continue;
    if (!stockYears.has(m[2])) stockYears.set(m[2], new Set());
    stockYears.get(m[2]).add(+m[1]);
  }
  const stocks = [...stockYears.keys()].sort();
  const thisYear = new Date().getFullYear();

  // ---- the repositories of a stock in a year -----------------------------
  function select(stock, year) {
    const nodes = [];
    const taken = new Set();
    const pattern = (t, anyYear) =>
      new RegExp(t.pattern.replace("{year}", anyYear ? "(?<year>\\d{4})" : String(year)).replace("{stock}", escRe(stock)));
    const mine = repos.filter((r) => r.name.includes(stock));
    const match = (t) => {
      const latest = t.years === "latest";
      const re = pattern(t, latest);
      let found = [];
      for (const r of t.pattern.includes("{stock}") ? mine : repos) {
        if (taken.has(r.name)) continue;
        const m = r.name.match(re);
        if (m) found.push({ r, m });
      }
      if (latest) {
        found = found.filter((x) => +x.m.groups.year <= year);
        const best = Math.max(...found.map((x) => +x.m.groups.year));
        found = found.filter((x) => +x.m.groups.year === best);
      }
      return found;
    };
    const add = (t, x) => {
      taken.add(x.r.name);
      const short = ((x.m.groups && x.m.groups.short) || "").replace(/^_/, "") || t.id;
      nodes.push({ id: x.r.name, type: t.id, repo: x.r, short, year: +x.r.name.slice(0, 4) });
    };
    // first the types named for the stock, then those that are not, which
    // belong to it by what is recorded or by the data they share with it
    const named = types.types.filter((t) => t.pattern.includes("{stock}"));
    const others = types.types.filter((t) => !t.pattern.includes("{stock}"));
    for (const t of named) {
      const found = match(t);
      for (const x of found) add(t, x);
      if (!found.length && t.required) {
        const name = `${year}_${stock}_${t.id}`;
        nodes.push({ id: name, type: t.id, repo: null, short: t.id, year });
      }
    }
    const own = new Set(nodes.filter((n) => n.repo).map((n) => n.id));
    const ownSources = new Set(nodes.flatMap((n) => sourcesOf(n.repo)));
    for (const t of others) {
      for (const x of match(t)) {
        const r = x.r;
        const recorded =
          (t.stocks === "rdbes" && rdbes.year === year &&
            (rdbes.links || []).some((l) => l.stock === stock && `${year}_all_RDBES_${l.country}` === r.name)) ||
          (t.stocks === "members" && ((types.members || {})[r.name] || []).includes(stock));
        const shares = sourcesOf(r).some((s) => own.has(s)) || ownSources.has(r.name);
        if (recorded || shares) add(t, x);
      }
      // a country with data for the stock whose repository is not there yet
      if (t.stocks === "rdbes" && rdbes.year === year) {
        for (const l of (rdbes.links || []).filter((l) => l.stock === stock)) {
          const name = `${year}_all_RDBES_${l.country}`;
          if (!taken.has(name)) {
            taken.add(name);
            nodes.push({ id: name, type: t.id, repo: null, short: l.country, year });
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return nodes;
  }

  // ---- the connections between them --------------------------------------
  function connect(nodes) {
    const edges = [];
    for (const f of types.flows) {
      if (f.indirect) {
        // one pipe from each to the first of the assessments, so that it
        // does not run behind the others: connected if any of them names it
        const targets = nodes.filter((n) => n.type === f.to);
        for (const a of nodes.filter((n) => n.type === f.from)) {
          if (!targets.length) continue;
          const naming = targets.filter((b) => sourcesOf(b.repo).includes(a.id));
          edges.push({
            from: a, to: targets[0], targets, indirect: true,
            key: naming.length ? "connected" : "not-connected",
            found: naming.length ? `named in the data of ${naming.map((b) => b.id).join(", ")}` : `not named in the data of ${targets.map((b) => b.id).join(", ")}`
          });
        }
        continue;
      }
      for (const a of nodes.filter((n) => n.type === f.from)) {
        for (const b of nodes.filter((n) => n.type === f.to)) {
          let key = "not-connected";
          let found;
          if (!a.repo || !b.repo) {
            found = "One of the two has no repository";
          } else if (f.via === "RDBES") {
            const up = a.repo.upload, down = b.repo.download;
            key = up && down ? "connected" : up || down ? "partial" : "not-connected";
            found = `${a.id} uploads to the RDBES: ${up ? "yes" : "not found in the code"}. ${b.id} downloads from it: ${down ? "yes" : "not found in the code"}`;
          } else {
            const named = sourcesOf(b.repo).includes(a.id);
            key = named ? "connected" : "not-connected";
            found = named ? `${b.id} names ${a.id} in its data` : `${b.id} does not name ${a.id} in its data`;
          }
          edges.push({ from: a, to: b, key, found, via: f.via, indirect: !!f.indirect });
        }
      }
    }
    return edges;
  }

  // ---- drawing -----------------------------------------------------------
  const W = 200, H = 44, GAP = 96, ROW = 58, HEAD = 30, LANE = 100;
  const statuses = {
    none: ["No repository", "There is no repository"],
    exists: ["Exists", "The readiness level is not looked for in this type of repository"],
    l0: ["No level", "No code found in the repository"],
    l1: ["Level 1", "TAF readiness level 1: the code is on GitHub"],
    l2: ["Level 2", "TAF readiness level 2: the code passes the QC test"]
  };
  const links = {
    connected: "Connected",
    partial: "Partly connected",
    "not-connected": "Not connected"
  };
  const statusOf = (n) => (!n.repo ? "none" : n.repo.level === "" ? "exists" : n.repo.level === "none" ? "l0" : "l" + n.repo.level);

  // the diagram of a stock in a year, or a small one for the gallery, with
  // no words in it and nothing to click
  function diagram(stock, year, thumb = false) {
    const nodes = select(stock, year);
    const edges = connect(nodes);

    const columns = types.columns.filter((c) => c.id === "assessment" || nodes.some((n) => !typeOf.get(n.type).lane && typeOf.get(n.type).column === c.id));
    const lane = nodes.filter((n) => typeOf.get(n.type).lane);
    const tallest = Math.max(1, ...columns.map((c) => nodes.filter((n) => typeOf.get(n.type).column === c.id).length));
    const top = HEAD + (lane.length ? LANE : 0);
    const bottom = top + tallest * ROW;
    const colX = new Map(columns.map((c, i) => [c.id, i * (W + GAP)]));

    // place the nodes
    for (const c of columns) {
      const here = nodes.filter((n) => !typeOf.get(n.type).lane && typeOf.get(n.type).column === c.id);
      here.forEach((n, i) => {
        n.x = colX.get(c.id);
        n.y = top + ((tallest - here.length) * ROW) / 2 + (i + 0.5) * ROW;
        n.col = columns.indexOf(c);
      });
    }
    const ax = colX.get("assessment");
    lane.forEach((n, i) => {
      n.x = ax + (i - (lane.length - 1) / 2) * (W + 24);
      n.y = 36 + H / 2;
    });
    const xs = nodes.map((n) => n.x);
    const minX = Math.min(0, ...xs) - 24;
    const maxX = Math.max((columns.length - 1) * (W + GAP), ...xs) + W + 24;

    // the pipes: from the right of one to the left of the next, turning in
    // the gap between them, or under the others when they skip a column, and
    // down from the lane along the top
    let skip = 0;
    const pipes = edges.map((e) => {
      const a = e.from, b = e.to;
      let d, mid;
      if (e.indirect) {
        // to the right of the heading of the column
        const x1 = a.x + W / 2, y1 = a.y + H / 2, x2 = b.x + W - 24, y2 = b.y - H / 2;
        const ym = (y1 + y2) / 2;
        d = `M${x1},${y1} C${x1},${ym} ${x2},${ym} ${x2},${y2}`;
        mid = [(x1 + x2) / 2, ym];
      } else if (b.col - a.col > 1) {
        const x1 = a.x + W, x2 = b.x, yb = bottom + 12 + 10 * skip++;
        d = `M${x1},${a.y} H${x1 + GAP / 3} V${yb} H${x2 - GAP / 3} V${b.y} H${x2}`;
        mid = [(x1 + x2) / 2, yb];
      } else {
        const x1 = a.x + W, x2 = b.x, xm = (x1 + x2) / 2;
        d = `M${x1},${a.y} H${xm} V${b.y} H${x2}`;
        // on the first stretch, which is this pipe's own
        mid = [(x1 + xm) / 2, a.y];
      }
      if (thumb) {
        return `<g class="pipe-g${e.indirect ? " indirect" : ""}"><path class="pipe-bg" d="${d}"/><path class="pipe s-${e.key}" d="${d}"/></g>`;
      }
      const title = `${a.id} to ${b.id}: ${links[e.key]}. ${e.found}`;
      const via = e.via
        ? `<rect class="via-bg" x="${mid[0] - 22}" y="${mid[1] - 8}" width="44" height="16" rx="3"/><text class="via" x="${mid[0]}" y="${mid[1] + 4}">${esc(e.via)}</text>`
        : "";
      return `<g class="pipe-g${e.indirect ? " indirect" : ""}" data-id="${esc(a.id)} ${esc(b.id)}" data-from="${esc(a.id)}" data-to="${esc(b.id)}"><title>${esc(title)}</title><path class="pipe-bg" d="${d}"/><path class="pipe s-${e.key}" d="${d}"/>${via}</g>`;
    });
    const height = bottom + 12 + 10 * skip + 10;

    const boxes = nodes.map((n) => {
      const t = typeOf.get(n.type);
      const key = statusOf(n);
      if (thumb) {
        return `<g class="node s-${key}"><rect class="box" x="${n.x}" y="${n.y - H / 2}" width="${W}" height="${H}" rx="6"/></g>`;
      }
      const label = n.type === "national" ? n.short : n.short.replace(/_/g, " ");
      const status = (t.years === "latest" ? n.year + " · " : "") + statuses[key][0];
      const from = sourcesOf(n.repo).filter((s) => s !== n.id);
      const title = [
        `${n.id} (${t.label})`,
        statuses[key][1],
        n.repo && n.repo.private ? "Private repository" : null,
        from.length ? "Takes data from " + from.join(", ") : null
      ].filter(Boolean).join(". ");
      const body =
        `<g class="node s-${key}" data-id="${esc(n.id)}"><title>${esc(title)}</title>` +
        `<rect class="box" x="${n.x}" y="${n.y - H / 2}" width="${W}" height="${H}" rx="6"/>` +
        `<circle class="lamp" cx="${n.x + 19}" cy="${n.y}" r="7"/>` +
        `<text class="node-name" x="${n.x + 34}" y="${n.y - 4}">${esc(label)}</text>` +
        `<text class="node-status" x="${n.x + 34}" y="${n.y + 12}">${esc(status)}</text></g>`;
      return n.repo ? `<a href="https://github.com/ices-taf/${esc(n.id)}">${body}</a>` : body;
    });

    const headings = columns.map((c) => `<text class="heading" x="${colX.get(c.id) + W / 2}" y="${(lane.length ? LANE : 0) + 16}">${esc(c.label)}</text>`);
    const laneBox = lane.length
      ? `<rect class="lane" x="${Math.min(...lane.map((n) => n.x)) - 12}" y="6" width="${(lane.length - 1) * (W + 24) + W + 24}" height="${H + 42}" rx="8"/>` +
        (thumb ? "" : `<text class="lane-label" x="${Math.min(...lane.map((n) => n.x))}" y="24">Benchmarks and reference points</text>`)
      : "";

    const width = maxX - minX;
    const svg = thumb
      ? `<svg viewBox="${minX} 0 ${width} ${height}" aria-hidden="true">${laneBox}${pipes.join("")}${boxes.join("")}</svg>`
      // no larger than it is drawn, so that a diagram of one or two boxes is
      // not blown up to the width of the page
      : `<svg viewBox="${minX} 0 ${width} ${height}" role="img" aria-labelledby="stock-svg-title" style="max-width: ${width}px; min-width: ${Math.min(760, width)}px">` +
        `<title id="stock-svg-title">The TAF repositories of ${esc(stock)} in ${year} and their connections</title>` +
        laneBox + pipes.join("") + headings.join("") + boxes.join("") + "</svg>";
    return { svg, nodes, edges };
  }

  function draw(stock, year) {
    const { svg, nodes, edges } = diagram(stock, year);
    document.getElementById("stock-diagram").innerHTML = svg;
    document.getElementById("stock-chosen").textContent = `${stock} in ${year}`;
    pick();
    table(nodes, edges);
  }

  // picking out a repository and those it is connected to
  function pick() {
    const svg = document.querySelector("#stock-diagram svg");
    const pipes = [...svg.querySelectorAll(".pipe-g")];
    const parts = [...svg.querySelectorAll("[data-id]")];
    const show = (id) => {
      const on = new Set([id]);
      for (const p of pipes) {
        if (p.dataset.from === id || p.dataset.to === id) {
          on.add(p.dataset.from);
          on.add(p.dataset.to);
          p.classList.add("on");
        } else p.classList.remove("on");
      }
      for (const n of svg.querySelectorAll(".node")) n.classList.toggle("on", on.has(n.dataset.id));
      svg.classList.add("picked");
    };
    const clear = () => svg.classList.remove("picked");
    for (const n of svg.querySelectorAll(".node")) {
      const target = n.closest("a") || n;
      target.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => show(n.dataset.id));
      target.addEventListener("focus", () => show(n.dataset.id));
      target.addEventListener("mouseleave", clear);
      target.addEventListener("blur", clear);
    }
  }

  function table(nodes, edges) {
    const rows = nodes.map((n) => {
      const t = typeOf.get(n.type);
      const into = edges.filter((e) => e.to === n || (e.targets || []).includes(n));
      const conn = into.map((e) => {
        const key = e.targets ? (sourcesOf(n.repo).includes(e.from.id) ? "connected" : "not-connected") : e.key;
        return `${esc(e.from.id)}: ${links[key].toLowerCase()}`;
      }).join("<br>");
      const repo = n.repo ? `<a href="https://github.com/ices-taf/${esc(n.id)}">${esc(n.id)}</a>` : `${esc(n.id)} (no repository)`;
      return `<tr><td>${esc(t.label)}</td><td>${repo}</td><td>${n.year}</td><td>${statuses[statusOf(n)][0]}</td><td>${conn}</td></tr>`;
    });
    document.getElementById("stock-table").innerHTML =
      "<thead><tr><th scope=\"col\">Type</th><th scope=\"col\">Repository</th><th scope=\"col\">Year</th><th scope=\"col\">Level</th><th scope=\"col\">Data from</th></tr></thead><tbody>" +
      rows.join("") + "</tbody>";
  }

  // the key to the diagram
  const lamp = (key) => `<span class="item" title="${esc(statuses[key][1])}"><svg width="16" height="16"><circle class="lamp s-${key}" cx="8" cy="8" r="6"/></svg>${statuses[key][0]}</span>`;
  const pipe = (key, extra = "") => `<span class="item"><svg width="40" height="16"><path class="pipe-bg" d="M4,8 L36,8"/><path class="pipe s-${key}" d="M4,8 L36,8"${extra}/></svg>${links[key]}</span>`;
  document.getElementById("stock-legend").innerHTML =
    "<div><strong>Repositories</strong>" + Object.keys(statuses).map(lamp).join("") + "</div>" +
    "<div><strong>Connections</strong>" + Object.keys(links).map((k) => pipe(k)).join("") + "</div>";

  // ---- choosing ----------------------------------------------------------
  // a year, then a stock from the gallery of those with repositories in it
  const yearPick = document.getElementById("stock-pick-year");
  const find = document.getElementById("stock-find");
  const onlyRdbes = document.getElementById("stock-rdbes");
  const rdbesStocks = new Set(rdbes.stocks || []);
  const gallery = document.getElementById("stock-gallery");
  const allYears = [...new Set([...stockYears.values()].flatMap((ys) => [...ys]))].sort((a, b) => b - a);
  yearPick.innerHTML = allYears.map((y) => `<option>${y}</option>`).join("");
  let chosen;

  const fillGallery = (year) => {
    const here = stocks.filter((s) => stockYears.get(s).has(year));
    gallery.innerHTML = here.length
      ? here.map((s) =>
          `<button type="button" class="stock-card" data-stock="${esc(s)}" aria-pressed="${s === chosen}">` +
          `<span class="stock-thumb">${diagram(s, year, true).svg}</span><span class="stock-code">${esc(s)}</span></button>`
        ).join("")
      : `<p class="stock-none">No stock has repositories named for ${year}.</p>`;
    filter();
  };
  const filter = () => {
    const q = find.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const cards = [...gallery.querySelectorAll(".stock-card")];
    for (const card of cards) {
      card.hidden = (!!q && !card.dataset.stock.includes(q)) || (onlyRdbes.checked && !rdbesStocks.has(card.dataset.stock));
    }
    const none = gallery.querySelector(".stock-none-shown");
    if (none) none.remove();
    if (cards.length && cards.every((c) => c.hidden)) {
      gallery.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", '<p class="stock-none stock-none-shown">No stock matches.</p>');
    }
  };
  const show = () => {
    const year = +yearPick.value;
    history.replaceState(null, "", `#stock=${encodeURIComponent(chosen)}&year=${year}`);
    for (const card of gallery.querySelectorAll(".stock-card")) card.setAttribute("aria-pressed", card.dataset.stock === chosen);
    draw(chosen, year);
  };

  const hash = new URLSearchParams(location.hash.slice(1));
  chosen = stocks.includes(hash.get("stock")) ? hash.get("stock") : stocks.includes("bll.27.3a47de") ? "bll.27.3a47de" : stocks[0];
  const wanted = +hash.get("year");
  yearPick.value = String(allYears.includes(wanted) ? wanted : allYears.find((y) => y <= thisYear) || allYears[0]);
  fillGallery(+yearPick.value);
  show();
  const selected = gallery.querySelector('[aria-pressed="true"]');
  if (selected) gallery.scrollTop = selected.offsetTop - gallery.offsetTop - 8;

  yearPick.addEventListener("change", () => { fillGallery(+yearPick.value); show(); });
  find.addEventListener("input", filter);
  onlyRdbes.addEventListener("change", filter);
  gallery.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    const card = e.target.closest(".stock-card");
    if (!card) return;
    chosen = card.dataset.stock;
    show();
  });

  // full screen: the diagram and its key are moved into the dialog and back
  const modal = document.getElementById("stock-modal");
  const home = document.getElementById("stock-home");
  const body = document.getElementById("stock-modal-body");
  const moved = [...home.children];
  document.body.append(modal);
  modal.addEventListener("show.bs.modal", () => body.append(...moved));
  modal.addEventListener("hidden.bs.modal", () => home.append(...moved));
});
</script>
```
